intro: Alaska is the most radio-dependent place in the United States, and it is not close. Most communities have no road connection, so aviation is transport rather than travel, and the airband carries flight-following, weather and passenger logistics that would go by phone anywhere else. Lake Hood in Anchorage is the busiest seaplane base on earth. Public radio here is genuinely infrastructure. And because there is so little electrical noise, HF and satellite reception is exceptional.
introz: 阿拉斯加是全美对无线电依赖最深的地方，而且差距很大。多数社区没有公路连接，所以航空是交通而不是旅行，航空波段上传递的是航迹跟踪、天气和旅客调度——这些事情在别处都会用电话解决。安克雷奇的 Lake Hood 是全球最繁忙的水上机场。这里的公共广播真的属于基础设施。而由于电气噪声极少，短波和卫星接收效果极为出色。

stations.z: 丛林飞行 · MULTICOM
stations.d: Off-airport operations: gravel bars, lake landings, glacier strips, hunting and fishing charters. In much of Alaska this frequency and 122.800 are the entire air traffic system. Pilots announce position and intention to nobody in particular, and somebody is usually listening.
stations.dz: 非机场作业：砾石滩、湖面降落、冰川跑道、狩猎和垂钓包机。在阿拉斯加大部分地区，这个频率和 122.800 就是全部的空中交通系统。飞行员向不特定对象通报位置和意图，而通常真的有人在听。

stations.z: 无塔机场公共频率 · 偏远跑道
紧急频率 · 在这里真的重要
stations.d: Alaska has more aircraft per capita and more accidents than any other state. Emergency locator transmitters on this frequency are not a theoretical concern.
stations.dz: 阿拉斯加的人均飞机数量和事故率都是全美最高的。这个频率上的紧急定位发射机不是理论上的担忧。

stations.z: Lake Hood 水上飞机作业
stations.d: The busiest seaplane base in the world, right next to Anchorage's international airport. Floatplanes leaving for lodges and remote lakes all summer. Listening from the shore path is a genuine Alaska experience.
stations.dz: 全球最繁忙的水上机场，就紧邻安克雷奇国际机场。整个夏季都有水上飞机飞往各处小屋和偏远湖泊。在湖畔步道收听是一种真正的阿拉斯加体验。

stations.z: 安克雷奇塔台
stations.d: One of the world's largest air-cargo hubs because it is the natural refuelling stop between Asia and North America. Overnight freighter traffic is heavy and international.
stations.dz: 全球最大的航空货运枢纽之一，因为它是亚洲与北美之间天然的加油点。夜间货机流量大且国际化。

stations.z: 安克雷奇区调 · 航路与海洋
stations.d: Controls a vast area including North Pacific oceanic routes. Sweep 128–136 MHz.
stations.dz: 管制范围极大，包括北太平洋海洋航路。扫 128–136 MHz。

stations.z: 短波空地通信 · 海洋位置报告
stations.d: Out over the North Pacific there is no VHF coverage, so aircraft report position by HF. Try 11.282, 8.843, 5.547 and 13.300 MHz. Hearing a crew read a position report from the middle of the ocean is one of the more evocative things a shortwave receiver can do.
stations.dz: 北太平洋上没有 VHF 覆盖，所以航班通过短波报告位置。可试 11.282、8.843、5.547 和 13.300 MHz。听到机组从大洋中央念出位置报告，是短波接收机能带来的最有画面感的体验之一。

stations.z: 海事 16 频道 · 内湾航道
stations.d: Commercial fishing fleets, Alaska Marine Highway ferries, cruise ships, tenders and the Coast Guard. In summer the southeast coast is one of the busiest marine radio environments in the country, and much of it is genuinely consequential traffic.
stations.dz: 商业渔船队、阿拉斯加海洋公路渡轮、邮轮、驳运船和海岸警卫队。夏季的东南沿海是全美最繁忙的海事无线电环境之一，而且很多通话事关生计与安全。

stations.z: 海警 22A 频道
stations.d: The Coast Guard in Alaska runs some of the hardest search-and-rescue operations anywhere.
stations.dz: 阿拉斯加的海岸警卫队执行着全球难度最高的一些搜救任务。

stations.z: 海事 06 频道 · 渔船队
stations.d: Crews talking to each other during salmon and crab seasons.
stations.dz: 鲑鱼和帝王蟹季节，船员之间的通话。

stations.z: 船桥互通 13 频道
NOAA 安克雷奇
stations.d: The marine and aviation forecast segments are the useful ones. Weather here changes fast and closes airstrips.
stations.dz: 海事和航空预报部分最有用。这里天气变化极快，会直接关闭跑道。

stations.z: NOAA 东南部 / 内湾航道
迪纳利国家公园
stations.d: Ranger operations, the park road bus system and mountaineering rescue on Denali itself. The 20,310 foot rescues run by the climbing rangers are among the most serious in the world. Scan 162–174 MHz.
stations.dz: 护林员作业、园内公路巴士系统，以及迪纳利峰上的登山救援。攀登护林员在 6190 米高度执行的救援属于全球最艰难的一类。扫 162–174 MHz。

stations.z: 跨部门航空守护频率
stations.d: Alaska has enormous wildfires that get little attention because they burn where nobody lives.
stations.dz: 阿拉斯加有规模巨大的野火，只因为烧在无人区而少有人关注。

stations.z: 2 米直通呼叫
stations.d: Amateur radio has a real role here. Volunteers run the communications network for the Iditarod, relaying checkpoint reports from places with no other connectivity — a genuine, unglamorous public service and a lovely thing to listen to in March.
stations.dz: 业余无线电在这里有真实的用途。志愿者为艾迪塔罗德狗拉雪橇赛搭建通信网络，从毫无其他连接手段的检查点转发报告——一项朴实无华的公共服务，三月里听起来很动人。

stations.z: 安克雷奇地区中继
stations.d: Repeaters are sparse and far apart. Confirm on RepeaterBook for Anchorage and Fairbanks.
stations.dz: 中继台稀疏且相距很远。请在 RepeaterBook 查 Anchorage 和 Fairbanks 确认。

stations.z: 70 厘米直通呼叫
KNBA 阿拉斯加原住民电台
stations.d: The first urban Native-owned public station in the country. Music and programming you will not hear anywhere else.
stations.dz: 全美第一家城市原住民自营公共电台，节目和音乐在别处听不到。

stations.z: KSKA 阿拉斯加公共媒体
KTOO 朱诺

stations.n: Village public radio and message services
stations.z: 村镇公共广播与留言服务
stations.d: Small rural stations across Alaska still run personal-message programmes, reading out messages for people in villages with no telephone. Sweep 88–108 MHz anywhere off the road system. This is public radio doing something that has largely disappeared from the rest of the country.
stations.dz: 阿拉斯加各地的小型乡村电台至今仍有“个人留言”节目，为没有电话的村镇居民念出留言。在公路网之外的任何地方扫 88–108 MHz。这是公共广播在做一件在美国其他地方基本消失了的事。

stations.d: Anchorage to Fairbanks through Denali. The railroad also makes flag stops for people living along the line with no road access — request stops by waving at the train.
stations.dz: 从安克雷奇经迪纳利到费尔班克斯。这条铁路还为沿线没有公路的居民提供招手停车——向列车挥手即可上车。

stations.z: 美空军高频指挥网与北极短波
stations.d: The high latitude and the near-total absence of electrical noise make Alaska one of the best HF listening locations in the United States, though auroral activity can wipe out a band without warning. Also 8.992, 11.175 and 15.016 MHz.
stations.dz: 高纬度加上几乎完全没有电气噪声，让阿拉斯加成为全美最好的短波收听地点之一——但极光活动会毫无预警地把一个频段完全抹掉。另有 8.992、11.175、15.016 MHz。

stations.z: 国际空间站语音下行
stations.d: The ISS orbit means passes here are low on the horizon rather than overhead. Polar-orbiting weather satellites, on the other hand, pass almost directly over Alaska on nearly every orbit.
stations.dz: 国际空间站的轨道使它在这里只能低仰角过顶。而极轨气象卫星几乎每一圈都近乎垂直经过阿拉斯加上方。

stations.n: NOAA-19 APT — many passes per day
stations.z: NOAA-19 图传 · 每天多次过顶
stations.d: This is the best place in the country to receive weather satellites. Polar orbits converge here, so you get far more passes and far longer ones than anywhere in the lower 48.
stations.dz: 这里是全美接收气象卫星最好的地方。极轨在此收敛，所以过顶次数和持续时间都远超美国本土。
